deliveroo.source: Deliveroo_Master_Consolidation.xlsx — Weekly Summary. + ops from Weekly Summary sheet

issues: Covers fell by 238 (12.5%) and spend per head rose by £1.01, but the £23 SPH target was missed.
Sales fell by £2,389.58 week on week but were £1,798.38 above target; the drop was put down to severe weather warnings and the end of the children's holidays reducing centre footfall.
Top sellers were Steak Tataki Ramen (279), Chicken Yakisoba (231) and Chicken Gyoza (204); Steak Nigiri, Sea Bream Nigiri and Clam Nigiri sold once each.
All additionals fell slightly and the 10% drinks, 20% sushi and 13.5% sides targets were missed.
Labour beat target by 0.74%; the FOH and BOH split was 48.1% and 51.9% against 45% and 55%, skewed by several staff working across FOH and BOH over the weekend, and rota changes are being made.
The budget rota is complete for the week commencing 26 October and drafted for the week commencing 2 November.

Food spend was 25.76% against the 25% target, because another site placed a food order on the M13 account, the Lynas delivery had to come on Saturday instead of Sunday because of the storm, and about £100 a week now goes on the frozen ramen promotion.
Food usage variance was -3.2% and wet usage variance -4.7%, both within the acceptable range.
Google reviews hit 100% against the 95% target (six 5 star and four 4 star), but review volume is too low and will be addressed once staffing is stable.

Recruitment: Esme starts as FOH supervisor on Thursday, a new chef from East Timor joins on 9 November and needs onboarding through Hanna, and a part time FOH candidate is likely to be onboarded after a trial shift.
Alberto Moniz is stepping up to supervisor, and to assistant head chef once he passes probation, and is being trained on orders and budgets.
BOH is stable, but sushi holidays in November need covering; sushi cover for the book tour event has been requested from Matt Polak and is awaiting confirmation.

Fire safety: a contractor visit on 26/10 found poor record keeping, an electrical installation certificate filed on Mapal as a PAT test, deep cleaning needs and a sprinkler above the fat fryer dating from the original build; all site compliance tasks now show as overdue.

The inspection was arranged by Ross with Joseph without telling the site; the PAT certificate is missing from the shared drive and TR19 is nearly out of date, though Ka Ho said these are minor fixes that will not affect service (EDI/NEW KPI meeting 27/10).
Ka Ho believes Han carried out PAT testing three to four months ago and will check his files, or send Han to redo the test if needed (EDI/NEW KPI meeting 27/10).
Pest control, electrical, gas and ventilation are completed.
Maintenance: the light above the donburi and the emergency light in the back corner where the ramen noodles are kept.
The broken wall tiles behind the grease trap still need a follow up with Kris; Kris is busy at another site but will visit next week (RM notes and EDI/NEW KPI meeting 27/10).
The floor around the old grip taped areas has missing panels causing trip hazards and grime build up; it can be fixed in house outside service hours, but time is short with the current staffing.
Deliveroo food quality, correct orders and the resulting reviews remain the area for improvement; reviews look better again, refunds are being disputed and are monitored closely.
Delivery had justified and unjustified complaints about pink chicken karaage (EDI/NEW KPI meeting 27/10).
Food cost was slightly high because of Lynas issues over the weekend, while wage revenue was good and budget labour was within target (EDI/NEW KPI meeting 27/10).
Promotions: the current Deliveroo and Slerp promotion and the university frozen ramen promotion.
Ka Ho is happy with Elliot's first week as restaurant manager, with labour and sales on target, and will visit on Wednesday to run through everything with him (Admin Meeting 26/10).
Slerp wave two rolled out smoothly without the printing bugs Aberdeen had before (Admin Meeting 26/10).
Sites without frozen ramen stock should restock from Shoreditch or Aberdeen (Admin Meeting 26/10).
Region: frozen ramen stock must be distributed first come, first served rather than spread across the week (EDI/NEW KPI meeting 27/10).

Region: Oisin introduced the new site dashboards and the Asana task and action tab, and managers must check and mark their items as done there; areas of improvement targets will be set once all meetings are complete (EDI/NEW KPI meeting 27/10).
